description: This file defines the 'Subscriptions' interface which specifies write operations for managing collections of local subscriptions in a pub/sub system. It includes methods for counting topics, managing subscribers and their subscriptions, creating snapshots, and exporting data for distributed use.

classes.name: Subscriptions
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for managing local subscriptions, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and exporting subscription data.

methods.name: countTopics
methods.description: Returns the total number of topics with active subscriptions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given ActorRef subscribes to any topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a stream of ActorRef objects representing subscribers to a specific topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an ActorRef to a set of topics with an optional filter predicate.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes an ActorRef from a set of topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber and all its subscriptions.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable copy of the current subscription state for distribution.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports an approximation of subscription data for distributed data system; can be forced to update.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether there are no active topics with subscribers.
